Going right would leave both cell (2,7) and cell (4,7) needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes down.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes right.
Going down would wall in number 10, the last number. So the line goes right.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
